llms.text:
# MOE Kompozit - Endustriyel Kompozit Cozumleri
> Karbon fiber, CTP / FRP ve hibrit kompozit urun uretimi yapan bagimsiz endustriyel kompozit ureticisi.

## Uretim Yetkinlikleri
- Karbon fiber bilesenleri: savunma, havacilik, enerji ve ulasim icin hafif parcalar.
- CTP / FRP tank ve borular: kimya, gida, su aritma ve endustriyel depolama.
- Pultruzyon profilleri: yapi, raf sistemleri ve ozel kesit profiller.
- RTM ve el yatirmasi: kompleks form, otomotiv, beyaz esya ve ozel seri uretim.
- Sehir mobilyasi ve endustriyel kompozit uygulamalari.

## Hedef Sektorler
Savunma, enerji, endustriyel depolama, kimya, altyapi, ulasim, sehir mobilyasi, denizcilik ve ozel proje uretimi.

## Standartlar
ISO 9001 odakli kalite sistemi, AS9100 baseline hedefi, teknik sartnameye gore malzeme sertifikasyonu ve proses kontrolu.

## Iletisim
- Website: https://karbonkompozit.com.tr
- Teklif ve teknik talepler: info@karbonkompozit.com.tr

## Web Hiyerarsisi
- /tr/urunler: 7 ana urun kategorisi.
- /tr/sektorler: sektor bazli uygulama rehberleri.
- /tr/hakkimizda: uretim altyapisi, kalite ve kurumsal bilgi.
- /tr/galeri: urun ve uretim gorselleri.
- /tr/blog: karbon fiber, CTP ve kompozit teknolojileri.
- /tr/iletisim: iletisim formu.
- /tr/teklif: online teklif portali.

## Anahtar Konular
Karbon fiber uretim, CTP tank, FRP boru, pultruzyon profil, RTM, resin transfer molding, el yatirmasi, kompozit malzeme, savunma kompozit, ruzgar turbini bileseni, kimyasal depolama tanki, kompozit izolator.

pages.text: B2B Composite Manufacturing Carbon Fiber, FRP and Fiberglass Composite Solutions We manage engineering alignment, sampling and serial production planning for carbon fiber, FRP and fiberglass-based composite parts within one B2B delivery flow. Explore Products Request an Offer 15+ Years in composites 500+ Project parts delivered AS9100 Precision manufacturing mindset ISO 9001 Process and quality discipline About Us Engineering Discipline in Composite Technologies Where science meets craftsmanship From carbon fiber to GRP, we support all your composite application needs with an engineering-led approach from design to serial production. Engineering Support on material, layup and process selection Prototype Sampling, revision and first validation stage Read More 15 + Years in composites Material Architecture Choose the Right Laminate for Your Application We position carbon fiber and GRP composites by weight, stiffness, chemical resistance and production scalability. CF Carbon Fiber A performance-oriented structure for parts requiring high stiffness, low weight and premium surface quality. Tensile Strength 600–1500 MPa Density 1.5–1.6 g/cm³ Elastic Modulus 70–120 GPa Thermal Stability High GF Fiberglass / GRP A versatile platform balancing chemical resistance, service life and cost for industrial applications. Tensile Strength 200–900 MPa Density 1.8–2.0 g/cm³ Elastic Modulus 20–45 GPa Thermal Stability Medium-High Industrial Applications Solutions for Diverse Industries We integrate the advantages of composite technology into sector-specific requirements. Defense High-strength protective panels and lightweight structural components. Energy Corrosion-resistant parts for wind and solar energy systems. Urban & Landscaping Modern urban furniture and durable landscaping elements. Storage Chemical-resistant tanks and enclosure systems. Custom Projects Tailored design and specialized production support. Solutions Our Products View All 01 / PRODUCT ■ Amusement Ride Cabins and Theme Park Products Composite Amusement Ride Equipment and Theme Park Products MOE Composite specializes in manufacturing amusement ride equipment, theme park products, ride cabins, game-machine bodies, decorative figures and custom composite parts from glass-fiber reinforced polyester (GRP/FRP). With modern production methods, an experienced technical team and consistent quality standards, we provide project-specific solutions for amusement ride manufacturers, theme parks, entertainment centers, municipalities, shopping malls and game-equipment producers in Türkiye and international markets. What Is Glass-Fiber Reinforced Polyester? GRP/FRP is a high-strength engineering material made from polyester resin reinforced with glass fiber. Its low weight, mechanical strength and resistance to outdoor conditions make it a widely used material for amusement and theme park applications. It does not rust or rot. It offers good impact resistance. It can be engineered for UV and outdoor exposure. It provides long service life with low maintenance needs. It enables complex and visually distinctive forms. Colors and surface finishes can be adapted to the project. Amusement Ride Cabins and Bodies We Manufacture In addition to decorative figures, MOE Composite manufactures composite cabins, seats and exterior bodies for a broad range of amusement and theme park equipment. Bumper car bodies Roller coaster car bodies Ferris wheel cabins Dance ride and ballerina ride seats Discovery and gondola cabins Swing ride and flying chair seats Carousel components Children's train and mini-train locomotives and cars Simulator and virtual-reality cabins Coin-operated and electric game-machine bodies Water park play components Themed play cabins and amusement vehicle bodies Decorative and Themed Composite Products We manufacture custom decorative pieces and figures in the dimensions, colors and visual concepts required by each project. Amusement park, mascot and cartoon-style figures Large sculptures and animal figures Dinosaur models and fairy-tale characters Pirate, jungle, safari and water park scenery Photo areas and themed entrance arches Advertising, shopping mall, event and festival decorations Project-Specific Composite Production Alongside standard products, we develop fully custom designs from technical drawings, 3D models or physical samples. 3D design and technical modeling CNC tooling and master model preparation Glass-fiber reinforced polyester production Gelcoat, paint and surface finishing Quality control, assembly and shipment Why Choose GRP/FRP? Lightweight and durable construction Composite bodies are lighter than comparable metal structures, simplifying handling and installation while providing mechanical performance suited to intensive use. UV and corrosion resistance Parts manufactured with the right resin, gelcoat and paint system provide durable surface performance against sunlight, rain and humidity without rusting or rotting. Low maintenance requirements Easy-to-clean surfaces retain their appearance over a long service period when used correctly and inspected periodically. Design freedom Composite production supports complex geometries, original characters, custom colors and project-specific surface details. MOE Composite Production Quality We use quality polyester resins, high-strength glass fiber and outdoor-grade gelcoat systems throughout production. From tooling design to final surface inspection, our controlled workflow targets attractive, durable and long-lasting products. Project-specific design and engineering support Tooling design and manufacturing Capacity for large composite parts UV-resistant surface options Shipment support for domestic and international projects Frequently Asked Questions Can composite polyester products be used outdoors? Yes. With a project-appropriate resin, UV-resistant gelcoat and paint system, products can be manufactured for exposure to sunlight, rain, humidity and temperature changes. Do you manufacture only decorative figures? No. We also manufacture bumper car bodies, roller coaster cars, Ferris wheel cabins, ride seats, game-machine bodies and fully custom composite components. Do you provide custom manufacturing? Yes. We manufacture from technical drawings, 3D models or samples according to the required dimensions, connection details, quantity, color and surface finish. A Composite Solution for Your Project Contact us for composite amusement and theme park products ranging from cabins and decorative figures to exterior bodies and fully custom components. 02 / PRODUCT ◆ Defense Industry Composite Parts Defense Industry Composite Parts Defense industry composite parts can be manufactured for lightweight structural panels, equipment enclosures, electronics housings, radome-like covers, protective outer shells and technical composite bodies under project confidentiality. Carbon fiber and fiberglass reinforced composites offer weight reduction, corrosion resistance and design flexibility compared with many metal alternatives. Technical Manufacturing Scope Tooling, prototype and serial production according to technical drawings and specifications Resin, fiber, wall thickness, insert and fastening-detail selection Electronics enclosures, protective covers, structural panels and custom body applications Controlled project management with NDA, sample approval and quality documentation Application Focus This product group is positioned for composite enclosures, panels and protective body components used in defense, aerospace and technical equipment projects; it is not a weapon or ammunition product. 03 / PRODUCT ◇ Composite Train Parts Composite Train Parts Composite train parts can be manufactured for rail vehicles as lightweight interior trims, ceiling panels, side wall covers, door surrounds, exterior access covers, nose/skirt panels and equipment housings. FRP and carbon fiber reinforced composite structures support weight reduction, corrosion resistance, repeatable surface quality and serial-production tooling discipline. Rail System Applications Interior and exterior body components for train, tram, metro and light rail vehicles Resin and laminate selection aligned to fire, smoke and mechanical requirements Tooling, sample approval and serial production planning for OEM dimensions Custom color, surface texture, fixing points and assembly details Quotation and Production Process Technical drawings, sample parts, target quantity, surface expectations and applicable standards allow a production scenario from prototype to serial manufacturing. 04 / PRODUCT ◇ FRP Water Storage Tank FRP Water Storage Tank The FRP water storage tank can be manufactured as a corrosion-resistant, lightweight and long-life vessel for utility water, process water, wastewater, fire-water and industrial storage projects. Its fiberglass reinforced body is engineered project by project according to volume, connection, manhole and support details. Technical Scope Horizontal or vertical tank form, custom volume and wall thickness Manhole, flange, inlet-outlet and drain details Resin system and laminate structure selected by stored media Field assembly, modular shipping or one-piece production options Application Areas Suitable for municipal facilities, treatment plants, industrial operations, agricultural irrigation infrastructure and project-specific storage needs. 05 / PRODUCT ◇ Municipal Garbage Container Municipal Garbage Container The municipal garbage container is a wheeled, reinforced and long-life FRP equipment concept for outdoor waste collection points. Its composite body helps reduce corrosion risk under salty air, moisture, cleaning chemicals and intensive daily use. Advantages for Municipal Use Wheeled body and connection details adaptable to emptying equipment Thick-wall composite construction with high impact tolerance Easy-wash, hygienic and smooth surface that does not retain odor easily Exterior color options aligned to district, facility or project identity Information Needed for Quotation Volume, wheel type, lid form, emptying-system compatibility, quantity and color expectations allow sample and serial production planning. 06 / PRODUCT ◇ Composite Litter Bin Composite Litter Bin The composite litter bin can be manufactured as a UV-resistant, impact-tolerant and low-maintenance urban equipment product for parks, gardens, walkways, campuses, hotels and municipal landscape areas. Its FRP body does not rust outdoors and can be adapted to different colors and hood designs. Product Features Rain-protected hood and easy-access waste opening Floor-fixable pedestal or project-specific base system Easy-clean inner surface and optional inner liner concept Color options aligned to municipal identity or landscape design Use Cases Suitable for parks, seaside walkways, social facilities, schools, campus areas, hotel gardens and outdoor urban furniture programs. Workflow From Prototype to Serial We manage sample validation, revision and serial production ramp within a single coordinated workflow. Technical Analysis Application requirements, operating conditions and material selection are defined. 01 02 Tooling & Prototype Project-specific mold design and initial sample production. Production Repeatable serial production via vacuum infusion or hand lay-up. 03 04 Quality Control Dimensional inspection, surface quality review and process deviation analysis. Delivery Packaging, documentation and on-time delivery planning. 05 Advantages Why Composite? High-performance solutions that push beyond the limits of traditional materials. 01 High Performance Composites combine the strength of steel with the lightness of aluminium, delivering superior performance across industrial applications. 02 Long Lifespan Exceptional corrosion and fatigue resistance ensures reliable service life under demanding conditions for years. 03 Design Freedom Complex geometries and custom tooling enable forms that conventional manufacturing simply cannot achieve. 04 Thermal Resistance Maintains structural integrity at elevated temperatures — the ideal choice for harsh industrial environments. 05 Low Maintenance Minimal upkeep requirements compared to metal alternatives significantly reduce total cost of ownership. 06 Sustainability Lightweight construction reduces energy consumption; long product lifespan cuts waste, supporting greener manufacturing. pages.text: Corporate About Us MOE Kompozit delivers application-focused solutions in carbon fiber, FRP and fiberglass composites from concept and sample validation to repeatable production. 10+ Years Sector Expertise 250+ Projects Successfully Delivered Dynamic Capacity Production Power MOE Kompozit engineering approach, production discipline, and composite part development focus. MOE Kompozit is an industrial solutions brand structured to support engineering, prototyping, and series production for carbon fiber, FRP, and fiberglass-based composite parts. How We Work We evaluate each project through application conditions, mechanical requirements, process compatibility, and total cost of ownership. Sample validation, process standardization, and ramp-up planning are handled within a single delivery flow. Focus Areas Carbon fiber structural parts FRP and fiberglass industrial body components Custom panels, profiles, and protective enclosure solutions Engineering support from prototype to serial production MOE Kompozit aims to be a disciplined production partner that speaks the same technical language as engineering teams. What We Do ◆ Custom product and sub-component development with carbon fiber and fiberglass reinforcement ◆ Panels, profiles, covers, housings and industrial structural parts ◆ Process setup from tooling and prototypes to repeatable production How We Work ◇ Define the technical need and operating conditions ◇ Select the right material stack and production method ◇ Plan sample, revision and production stages Partnership Ready to initiate a composite project? No:6A 06890 Kahramankazan / Ankara - Türkiye Phone +90 530 961 94 17 Email info@karbonkompozit.com.tr Working Hours Monday - Friday: 08:00 - 17:00 How We Respond ◇ We review your request and clarify technical scope, operating environment, quantity and critical performance expectations. ◇ If needed, we request additional details around material, process, tolerance, drawings or sampling needs. ◇ We then share the right product, sample or quotation path together with a clear lead-time expectation. Send a Message Share your project details — we take it from there Your Full Name example@company.com +90 5XX XXX XX XX Company Name Subject Write your message here... Send Location Inquiry Frequently asked questions Short answers about our B2B composite manufacturing and quotation workflow. Is there a minimum order quantity (MOQ)? MOQ depends on part geometry, tooling needs, material and process type. Share drawings or specifications via the contact form and we will assess your project specifically. How long does sample production take? Lead time varies with complexity, finish expectations and existing tooling. After receiving your request we share an indicative timeline and next steps. Which materials do you work with? We support carbon fiber, FRP/GRP, fiberglass and hybrid reinforcement structures for panels, profiles, enclosures and custom industrial parts. Which technical drawing formats do you accept? STEP, IGES, DXF/DWG and PDF specifications are commonly used. You can attach files through the quote or contact flow. Do you support export shipping and logistics? B2B shipments can include export-oriented packaging and documentation; details are aligned per project.

pages.text: Quote Request Let us prepare a project-specific quote, process recommendation and production approach based on your material type, dimensions, quantity, target delivery and application conditions. Why Us? Engineering Support We clarify your technical requirements together — from material selection and production route to tolerances and surface quality. Why Us? pages.text: Catalogue Our Products Carbon fiber, FRP and fiberglass composite products prepared for B2B applications that require lightweighting, durability, surface quality and repeatable production. All Categories FRP Products Fiberglass Products Industrial Profiles Carbon Fiber Products Custom Manufacturing 01 / PRODUCT ■ Amusement Ride Cabins and Theme Park Products Composite Amusement Ride Equipment and Theme Park Products MOE Composite specializes in manufacturing amusement ride equipment, theme park products, ride cabins, game-machine bodies, decorative figures and custom composite parts from glass-fiber reinforced polyester (GRP/FRP). With modern production methods, an experienced technical team and consistent quality standards, we provide project-specific solutions for amusement ride manufacturers, theme parks, entertainment centers, municipalities, shopping malls and game-equipment producers in Türkiye and international markets. What Is Glass-Fiber Reinforced Polyester? GRP/FRP is a high-strength engineering material made from polyester resin reinforced with glass fiber. Its low weight, mechanical strength and resistance to outdoor conditions make it a widely used material for amusement and theme park applications. It does not rust or rot. It offers good impact resistance. It can be engineered for UV and outdoor exposure. It provides long service life with low maintenance needs. It enables complex and visually distinctive forms. Colors and surface finishes can be adapted to the project. Amusement Ride Cabins and Bodies We Manufacture In addition to decorative figures, MOE Composite manufactures composite cabins, seats and exterior bodies for a broad range of amusement and theme park equipment. Bumper car bodies Roller coaster car bodies Ferris wheel cabins Dance ride and ballerina ride seats Discovery and gondola cabins Swing ride and flying chair seats Carousel components Children's train and mini-train locomotives and cars Simulator and virtual-reality cabins Coin-operated and electric game-machine bodies Water park play components Themed play cabins and amusement vehicle bodies Decorative and Themed Composite Products We manufacture custom decorative pieces and figures in the dimensions, colors and visual concepts required by each project. Amusement park, mascot and cartoon-style figures Large sculptures and animal figures Dinosaur models and fairy-tale characters Pirate, jungle, safari and water park scenery Photo areas and themed entrance arches Advertising, shopping mall, event and festival decorations Project-Specific Composite Production Alongside standard products, we develop fully custom designs from technical drawings, 3D models or physical samples. 3D design and technical modeling CNC tooling and master model preparation Glass-fiber reinforced polyester production Gelcoat, paint and surface finishing Quality control, assembly and shipment Why Choose GRP/FRP? Lightweight and durable construction Composite bodies are lighter than comparable metal structures, simplifying handling and installation while providing mechanical performance suited to intensive use. UV and corrosion resistance Parts manufactured with the right resin, gelcoat and paint system provide durable surface performance against sunlight, rain and humidity without rusting or rotting. Low maintenance requirements Easy-to-clean surfaces retain their appearance over a long service period when used correctly and inspected periodically. Design freedom Composite production supports complex geometries, original characters, custom colors and project-specific surface details. MOE Composite Production Quality We use quality polyester resins, high-strength glass fiber and outdoor-grade gelcoat systems throughout production. From tooling design to final surface inspection, our controlled workflow targets attractive, durable and long-lasting products. Project-specific design and engineering support Tooling design and manufacturing Capacity for large composite parts UV-resistant surface options Shipment support for domestic and international projects Frequently Asked Questions Can composite polyester products be used outdoors? Yes. With a project-appropriate resin, UV-resistant gelcoat and paint system, products can be manufactured for exposure to sunlight, rain, humidity and temperature changes. Do you manufacture only decorative figures? No. We also manufacture bumper car bodies, roller coaster cars, Ferris wheel cabins, ride seats, game-machine bodies and fully custom composite components. Do you provide custom manufacturing? Yes. We manufacture from technical drawings, 3D models or samples according to the required dimensions, connection details, quantity, color and surface finish. A Composite Solution for Your Project Contact us for composite amusement and theme park products ranging from cabins and decorative figures to exterior bodies and fully custom components. 02 / PRODUCT ◆ Defense Industry Composite Parts Defense Industry Composite Parts Defense industry composite parts can be manufactured for lightweight structural panels, equipment enclosures, electronics housings, radome-like covers, protective outer shells and technical composite bodies under project confidentiality. Carbon fiber and fiberglass reinforced composites offer weight reduction, corrosion resistance and design flexibility compared with many metal alternatives. Technical Manufacturing Scope Tooling, prototype and serial production according to technical drawings and specifications Resin, fiber, wall thickness, insert and fastening-detail selection Electronics enclosures, protective covers, structural panels and custom body applications Controlled project management with NDA, sample approval and quality documentation Application Focus This product group is positioned for composite enclosures, panels and protective body components used in defense, aerospace and technical equipment projects; it is not a weapon or ammunition product. 03 / PRODUCT ◇ Composite Train Parts Composite Train Parts Composite train parts can be manufactured for rail vehicles as lightweight interior trims, ceiling panels, side wall covers, door surrounds, exterior access covers, nose/skirt panels and equipment housings. FRP and carbon fiber reinforced composite structures support weight reduction, corrosion resistance, repeatable surface quality and serial-production tooling discipline. Rail System Applications Interior and exterior body components for train, tram, metro and light rail vehicles Resin and laminate selection aligned to fire, smoke and mechanical requirements Tooling, sample approval and serial production planning for OEM dimensions Custom color, surface texture, fixing points and assembly details Quotation and Production Process Technical drawings, sample parts, target quantity, surface expectations and applicable standards allow a production scenario from prototype to serial manufacturing. 04 / PRODUCT ◇ FRP Water Storage Tank FRP Water Storage Tank The FRP water storage tank can be manufactured as a corrosion-resistant, lightweight and long-life vessel for utility water, process water, wastewater, fire-water and industrial storage projects. Its fiberglass reinforced body is engineered project by project according to volume, connection, manhole and support details. Technical Scope Horizontal or vertical tank form, custom volume and wall thickness Manhole, flange, inlet-outlet and drain details Resin system and laminate structure selected by stored media Field assembly, modular shipping or one-piece production options Application Areas Suitable for municipal facilities, treatment plants, industrial operations, agricultural irrigation infrastructure and project-specific storage needs. 05 / PRODUCT ◇ Municipal Garbage Container Municipal Garbage Container The municipal garbage container is a wheeled, reinforced and long-life FRP equipment concept for outdoor waste collection points. Its composite body helps reduce corrosion risk under salty air, moisture, cleaning chemicals and intensive daily use. Advantages for Municipal Use Wheeled body and connection details adaptable to emptying equipment Thick-wall composite construction with high impact tolerance Easy-wash, hygienic and smooth surface that does not retain odor easily Exterior color options aligned to district, facility or project identity Information Needed for Quotation Volume, wheel type, lid form, emptying-system compatibility, quantity and color expectations allow sample and serial production planning. 06 / PRODUCT ◇ Composite Litter Bin Composite Litter Bin The composite litter bin can be manufactured as a UV-resistant, impact-tolerant and low-maintenance urban equipment product for parks, gardens, walkways, campuses, hotels and municipal landscape areas. Its FRP body does not rust outdoors and can be adapted to different colors and hood designs. Product Features Rain-protected hood and easy-access waste opening Floor-fixable pedestal or project-specific base system Easy-clean inner surface and optional inner liner concept Color options aligned to municipal identity or landscape design Use Cases Suitable for parks, seaside walkways, social facilities, schools, campus areas, hotel gardens and outdoor urban furniture programs. 07 / PRODUCT ◇ Composite Coffin Composite Coffin The composite coffin can be engineered as a lightweight, hygienic and controlled-surface product family for funeral services, municipal service units, funeral-sector suppliers and export-oriented B2B programs. Its non-porous FRP surface supports easy cleaning and dimensional repeatability in serial production. Technical Approach Lightweight handling ergonomics and rigid body structure Smooth gelcoat surface suitable for cleaning and disinfection Standard or customer-specific dimensions and colors Base and side reinforcement aligned to logistics and stacking needs Project Use After sample approval, technical specification, quantity and delivery plan are clarified, a production scenario can be prepared for domestic supply or export distribution. 08 / PRODUCT ◇ FRP Waste Container FRP Waste Container The FRP waste container is designed as a lightweight, corrosion-resistant and easy-clean composite body for municipalities, industrial sites, campuses and outdoor landscape projects. Its fiberglass reinforced polyester structure helps reduce rust, surface deformation and maintenance issues commonly associated with metal containers. Manufacturing Scope Project-specific volume, lid and body forms UV-resistant gelcoat surface or custom RAL finish Forklift pockets, reinforced side ribs, hinged lid and thick-wall composite body Repeatable mold discipline for serial production Use Cases Suitable for municipal waste points, factory yards, hotels, social facilities, campuses, parks and outdoor equipment programs. 09 / PRODUCT ◇ Decorative Composite Planters and Vases Decorative Composite Planters and Vases A decorative composite planter, vase and urn product family for landscape, municipal, hotel garden, social facility and outdoor design projects. Product Scope Horizontal planters, upright vases, urns, amphora forms and garden sets Bronze, terracotta, cream, mustard, aged and project-specific finishes Lightweight composite body suitable for outdoor conditions Project Use All visuals are presented under one product family. Dimensions, colors, surface effects and quantities can be planned project by project from the same mold family. 10 / PRODUCT ◇ Fiberglass Service Cover Sample fiberglass service cover entry for outdoor equipment requiring light weight, corrosion resistance, and easy installation. 11 / PRODUCT ◇ FRP Protective Enclosure Panel FRP Protective Enclosure Panel Glass fiber reinforced polyester protective panel designed for industrial body, cover and enclosure applications where field durability, chemical resistance and repeatable production are required. Production Scope Machine bodies, protective covers, service lids and enclosure panels Project-based mold, lamination, trimming and assembly preparation Gelcoat, paint and surface options for outdoor conditions Use Cases Suitable for municipal equipment, field cabinets, machine guards, service covers and technical parts exposed to weather or chemical conditions. 12 / PRODUCT ◇ Carbon Fiber Panel Prototype A sample carbon fiber reinforced panel prototype entry for lightweight structural parts, design validation, and pre-series production planning. B2B catalogue Need composite parts for series production, amusement park products, custom dimensions, or technical specifications? Each product line in the catalogue is reviewed against material, process, surface finish, color, volume, and lead-time requirements. Contact us directly for quotation and engineering input, including amusement and theme park applications. Request a quote Talk to engineering

Composite Amusement Ride Equipment and Theme Park Products

MOE Composite specializes in manufacturing amusement ride equipment, theme park products, ride cabins, game-machine bodies, decorative figures and custom composite parts from glass-fiber reinforced polyester (GRP/FRP).

With modern production methods, an experienced technical team and consistent quality standards, we provide project-specific solutions for amusement ride manufacturers, theme parks, entertainment centers, municipalities, shopping malls and game-equipment producers in Türkiye and international markets.

What Is Glass-Fiber Reinforced Polyester?

GRP/FRP is a high-strength engineering material made from polyester resin reinforced with glass fiber. Its low weight, mechanical strength and resistance to outdoor conditions make it a widely used material for amusement and theme park applications.

  • It does not rust or rot.
  • It offers good impact resistance.
  • It can be engineered for UV and outdoor exposure.
  • It provides long service life with low maintenance needs.
  • It enables complex and visually distinctive forms.
  • Colors and surface finishes can be adapted to the project.

Amusement Ride Cabins and Bodies We Manufacture

In addition to decorative figures, MOE Composite manufactures composite cabins, seats and exterior bodies for a broad range of amusement and theme park equipment.

  • Bumper car bodies
  • Roller coaster car bodies
  • Ferris wheel cabins
  • Dance ride and ballerina ride seats
  • Discovery and gondola cabins
  • Swing ride and flying chair seats
  • Carousel components
  • Children's train and mini-train locomotives and cars
  • Simulator and virtual-reality cabins
  • Coin-operated and electric game-machine bodies
  • Water park play components
  • Themed play cabins and amusement vehicle bodies

Decorative and Themed Composite Products

We manufacture custom decorative pieces and figures in the dimensions, colors and visual concepts required by each project.

  • Amusement park, mascot and cartoon-style figures
  • Large sculptures and animal figures
  • Dinosaur models and fairy-tale characters
  • Pirate, jungle, safari and water park scenery
  • Photo areas and themed entrance arches
  • Advertising, shopping mall, event and festival decorations

Project-Specific Composite Production

Alongside standard products, we develop fully custom designs from technical drawings, 3D models or physical samples.

  1. 3D design and technical modeling
  2. CNC tooling and master model preparation
  3. Glass-fiber reinforced polyester production
  4. Gelcoat, paint and surface finishing
  5. Quality control, assembly and shipment

Why Choose GRP/FRP?

Lightweight and durable construction

Composite bodies are lighter than comparable metal structures, simplifying handling and installation while providing mechanical performance suited to intensive use.

UV and corrosion resistance

Parts manufactured with the right resin, gelcoat and paint system provide durable surface performance against sunlight, rain and humidity without rusting or rotting.

Low maintenance requirements

Easy-to-clean surfaces retain their appearance over a long service period when used correctly and inspected periodically.

Design freedom

Composite production supports complex geometries, original characters, custom colors and project-specific surface details.

MOE Composite Production Quality

We use quality polyester resins, high-strength glass fiber and outdoor-grade gelcoat systems throughout production. From tooling design to final surface inspection, our controlled workflow targets attractive, durable and long-lasting products.

  • Project-specific design and engineering support
  • Tooling design and manufacturing
  • Capacity for large composite parts
  • UV-resistant surface options
  • Shipment support for domestic and international projects

Frequently Asked Questions

Can composite polyester products be used outdoors?

Yes. With a project-appropriate resin, UV-resistant gelcoat and paint system, products can be manufactured for exposure to sunlight, rain, humidity and temperature changes.

Do you manufacture only decorative figures?

No. We also manufacture bumper car bodies, roller coaster cars, Ferris wheel cabins, ride seats, game-machine bodies and fully custom composite components.

Do you provide custom manufacturing?

Yes. We manufacture from technical drawings, 3D models or samples according to the required dimensions, connection details, quantity, color and surface finish.

A Composite Solution for Your Project

Contact us for composite amusement and theme park products ranging from cabins and decorative figures to exterior bodies and fully custom components.

Çözümler Ürünlerimiz Tümünü Gör 01 / PRODUCT ■ Lunapark Oyuncakları Kompozit Lunapark Ekipmanları ve Tema Parkı Ürünleri MOE Kompozit, cam elyaf takviyeli kompozit polyester (CTP/FRP) malzemeden lunapark ekipmanları, tema parkı ürünleri, eğlence parkı kabinleri, oyun makinesi gövdeleri, dekoratif figürler ve özel tasarım kompozit parçalar üreten uzman bir üreticidir. Modern üretim teknolojileri, deneyimli teknik ekibi ve yüksek kalite standartlarıyla Türkiye ve uluslararası pazarlardaki lunapark üreticileri, tema parkları, eğlence merkezleri, belediyeler, AVM'ler ve oyun ekipmanı üreticileri için projeye özel çözümler sunar. Kompozit (CTP/FRP) Nedir? CTP/FRP, cam elyafı ile güçlendirilmiş polyester reçineden oluşan yüksek dayanımlı bir mühendislik malzemesidir. Hafif yapısı, yüksek mukavemeti ve dış ortam koşullarına karşı direnci sayesinde lunapark ve tema parkı sektöründe yaygın olarak tercih edilir. Paslanmaz ve çürümez. Darbelere karşı dayanıklıdır. UV ve dış ortam koşullarına uygun üretilebilir. Uzun süre düşük bakım ihtiyacı sunar. Karmaşık ve estetik formlara imkân verir. Renk ve yüzey seçenekleri projeye göre uyarlanabilir. Ürettiğimiz Lunapark Kabinleri ve Gövdeleri MOE Kompozit, dekoratif figürlerin yanı sıra lunapark ve tema parklarında kullanılan eğlence ekipmanlarının kompozit kabin, oturak ve dış gövdelerini de üretir. MOE Kompozit Üretim Kalitesi Üretimin her aşamasında kaliteli polyester reçineler, yüksek mukavemetli cam elyafı ve dış ortama uygun jelcoat sistemleri kullanıyoruz. Hızlı Prototip Numune ve prototip aşamasını kısa sürede tamamlayarak revizyona açık bir süreç sunuyoruz. Neden Biz? Seri Üretim Onaylanan prototipten tutarlı seri üretime geçiş için ölçeklenebilir bir proses yapısı kuruyoruz. Ürün Talebi Servis / Mühendislik Yedek Parça 01 İletişim Bilgileri Ad Soyad E-posta Telefon Firma 02 Proje Detayları İlgilenilen Ürün/Hizmet Ürün Kategorisi Ürün Kategorisi Karbon Fiber CTP / FRP Cam Elyaf Panel / Levha Profil / Boru Tank / Depo Kompozit Saksı / Peyzaj Özel Parça Sektör / Kullanım Alanı Miktar Termin Beklentisi Malzeme / Reçine Ölçü / Form Kullanım Ortamı Yüzey / Renk Beklentisi Proje Detayları 03 Dosya Ekle (Teknik Çizim, Şartname vb.) Malzeme secimi: karbon fiber, CTP, cam elyaf veya hibrit cozumler Üretim rotası: kalıplama, panel, profil, boru ya da özel parça süreci Miktar, termin, yüzey beklentisi, kalite ve lojistik planlama Ücretsiz ve bağlayıcı değildir Sıkça Sorulan Sorular Teklif süreci ne kadar sürer? Teknik çizim olmasa da boyut, kullanım koşulları ve adet bilgisi ile başlayabiliriz; gerekirse teknik çizim sürecinde de destek sağlıyoruz.

pages.text: Catalogue Ürünlerimiz Karbon fiber, CTP ve cam elyaf kompozit urunler; hafiflik, dayanim, yuzey kalitesi ve proses tekrarlanabilirligi gerektiren B2B uygulamalar icin gelistirildi. Tüm Kategoriler Belediyeler İçin Ürünler Lunapark Ürünleri Peyzaj Ürünleri Karbon Fiber Ürünler Özel Üretim 01 / PRODUCT ■ Lunapark Oyuncakları Kompozit Lunapark Ekipmanları ve Tema Parkı Ürünleri MOE Kompozit, cam elyaf takviyeli kompozit polyester (CTP/FRP) malzemeden lunapark ekipmanları, tema parkı ürünleri, eğlence parkı kabinleri, oyun makinesi gövdeleri, dekoratif figürler ve özel tasarım kompozit parçalar üreten uzman bir üreticidir. Modern üretim teknolojileri, deneyimli teknik ekibi ve yüksek kalite standartlarıyla Türkiye ve uluslararası pazarlardaki lunapark üreticileri, tema parkları, eğlence merkezleri, belediyeler, AVM'ler ve oyun ekipmanı üreticileri için projeye özel çözümler sunar. Kompozit (CTP/FRP) Nedir? CTP/FRP, cam elyafı ile güçlendirilmiş polyester reçineden oluşan yüksek dayanımlı bir mühendislik malzemesidir. Hafif yapısı, yüksek mukavemeti ve dış ortam koşullarına karşı direnci sayesinde lunapark ve tema parkı sektöründe yaygın olarak tercih edilir. Paslanmaz ve çürümez. Darbelere karşı dayanıklıdır. UV ve dış ortam koşullarına uygun üretilebilir. Uzun süre düşük bakım ihtiyacı sunar. Karmaşık ve estetik formlara imkân verir. Renk ve yüzey seçenekleri projeye göre uyarlanabilir. Ürettiğimiz Lunapark Kabinleri ve Gövdeleri MOE Kompozit, dekoratif figürlerin yanı sıra lunapark ve tema parklarında kullanılan eğlence ekipmanlarının kompozit kabin, oturak ve dış gövdelerini de üretir. Çarpışan oto kabinleri Roller coaster ve hız treni vagon gövdeleri Dönme dolap kabinleri Balerin ünitesi oturakları Discovery ve gondol kabinleri Salıncak ve uçan sandalye koltukları Atlı karınca parçaları Çocuk ve mini tren lokomotifleri ile vagonları Simülatör ve VR oyun kabinleri Jetonlu ve elektrikli oyun makinesi gövdeleri Su parkı oyun elemanları Tematik oyun ve eğlence parkı araç gövdeleri Dekoratif ve Tematik Kompozit Ürünler İstenilen ölçü, renk ve konsepte uygun özel dekor ve figür üretimi yapılabilir. Lunapark, maskot ve çizgi karakter figürleri Dev heykeller ve hayvan figürleri Dinozor ve masal kahramanı maketleri Korsan, orman, safari ve su parkı dekorları Fotoğraf çekim alanları ve tematik giriş takları Reklam, AVM organizasyonu ve festival dekorları Projeye Özel Kompozit Üretim Süreci Standart ürünlerin yanında teknik resim, 3D model veya numune üzerinden tamamen projeye özel tasarımlar geliştiriyoruz. 3D tasarım ve teknik modelleme CNC kalıp ve master model hazırlığı Cam elyaf takviyeli polyester üretimi Jelcoat, boya ve yüzey işlemleri Kalite kontrol, montaj ve sevkiyat Neden Kompozit Polyester? Hafif ve dayanıklı yapı Metale göre daha hafif olan kompozit gövdeler taşıma ve montaj kolaylığı sağlarken yoğun kullanıma uygun mekanik dayanım sunar. UV ve korozyon direnci Doğru reçine, jelcoat ve boya sistemiyle üretilen parçalar güneş, yağmur ve neme karşı uzun ömürlü yüzey performansı sağlar; paslanma ve çürüme yapmaz. Düşük bakım maliyeti Kolay temizlenebilir yüzeyler, uygun kullanım ve periyodik kontrollerle uzun süre estetik görünümünü korur. Tasarım özgürlüğü Karmaşık geometriler, özgün karakterler, farklı renkler ve projeye özel yüzey detayları kompozit üretim teknolojisiyle uygulanabilir. MOE Kompozit Üretim Kalitesi Üretimin her aşamasında kaliteli polyester reçineler, yüksek mukavemetli cam elyafı ve dış ortama uygun jelcoat sistemleri kullanıyoruz. Kalıp tasarımından son yüzey kontrolüne kadar izlenen üretim süreciyle estetik, dayanıklı ve uzun ömürlü ürünler hedefliyoruz. Projeye özel tasarım ve mühendislik desteği Kalıp tasarımı ve imalatı Büyük ölçekli parça üretim kapasitesi UV dayanımlı yüzey seçenekleri Türkiye ve yurt dışı projelerine sevkiyat Sık Sorulan Sorular Kompozit polyester ürünler dış mekânda kullanılabilir mi? Evet. Projeye uygun reçine, UV dayanımlı jelcoat ve boya sistemi seçildiğinde güneş, yağmur, nem ve sıcaklık değişimlerine uygun ürünler üretilebilir. Sadece dekoratif figür mü üretiyorsunuz? Hayır. Figürlerin yanı sıra çarpışan oto kabinleri, roller coaster vagonları, dönme dolap kabinleri, oturaklar, oyun makinesi gövdeleri ve özel tasarım kompozit parçalar üretiyoruz. Özel tasarım üretim yapıyor musunuz? Evet. Teknik resim, 3D model veya numune üzerinden ölçü, bağlantı detayı, adet, renk ve yüzey beklentilerine göre proje bazlı üretim gerçekleştiriyoruz. Projeniz İçin Kompozit Çözüm Lunapark ve tema parkı projelerinizde kabinden dekoratif figüre, dış gövdeden özel tasarım parçaya kadar ihtiyaç duyduğunuz kompozit ürünler için bizimle iletişime geçebilirsiniz. 02 / PRODUCT ◆ Savunma Sanayi Kompozit Parçaları Savunma Sanayi Kompozit Parçaları Savunma sanayi kompozit parçaları; hafif yapısal panel, ekipman muhafazası, elektronik kutu gövdesi, radom benzeri kapak, koruyucu dış kabuk ve teknik kompozit gövde ihtiyaçları için proje gizliliğine uygun şekilde üretilebilir. Karbon fiber ve cam elyaf takviyeli kompozitler, metal alternatiflere göre ağırlık avantajı, korozyon direnci ve tasarım esnekliği sunar. Teknik Üretim Kapsamı Teknik şartname ve çizime göre kalıp, prototip ve seri üretim Reçine, elyaf, cidar kalınlığı, insert ve bağlantı detayı seçimi Elektronik muhafaza, koruyucu kapak, yapısal panel ve özel gövde uygulamaları NDA, numune onayı ve kalite dokümantasyonu ile kontrollü proje yönetimi Kullanım Alanları Bu ürün grubu silah veya mühimmat üretimi değil; savunma, havacılık ve teknik ekipman projelerinde kullanılan kompozit muhafaza, panel ve koruyucu gövde bileşenleri için konumlandırılmıştır. 03 / PRODUCT ◇ Kompozit Tren Parçaları Kompozit Tren Parçaları Kompozit tren parçaları; raylı sistem araçlarında iç trim, tavan paneli, yan duvar kaplaması, kapı çevresi, dış kapak, burun/etek paneli ve ekipman muhafazası gibi hafif parça ihtiyaçları için proje bazlı üretilebilir. CTP ve karbon fiber takviyeli kompozit yapı; ağırlık azaltma, korozyon direnci, tekrarlanabilir yüzey kalitesi ve seri üretim kalıp disiplini sağlar. Raylı Sistem Uygulamaları Tren, tramvay, metro ve hafif raylı sistem iç/dış gövde parçaları Yangın, duman ve mekanik dayanım beklentilerine göre reçine ve laminat seçimi OEM ölçülerine uygun kalıp, numune onayı ve seri üretim planı Renk, yüzey dokusu, bağlantı noktası ve montaj detayı uyarlaması Teklif ve Üretim Süreci Teknik çizim, numune parça, hedef adet, yüzey beklentisi ve varsa standart gereksinimleri paylaşıldığında prototipten seri üretime kadar uygulanabilir üretim senaryosu hazırlanabilir. 04 / PRODUCT ◇ CTP Su Deposu CTP Su Deposu CTP su deposu; içme suyu dışı kullanım suyu, proses suyu, atık su, yangın suyu ve endüstriyel depolama projeleri için korozyona dayanıklı, hafif ve uzun ömürlü tank gövdesi olarak üretilebilir. Cam elyaf takviyeli yapı; hacim, bağlantı, menhol ve kaide detaylarına göre proje bazında mühendislikle netleştirilir. Teknik Kapsam Yatay veya dikey tank formu, özel hacim ve cidar kalınlığı Menhol, flanş, giriş-çıkış ağzı ve tahliye detayları İçeriğe göre reçine sistemi ve laminat yapısı seçimi Yerinde montaj, modüler sevkiyat veya tek parça üretim seçenekleri Uygulama Alanları Belediye tesisleri, arıtma sahaları, endüstriyel işletmeler, tarımsal sulama altyapıları ve özel proje depolama ihtiyaçları için değerlendirilebilir. 05 / PRODUCT ◇ Belediye Çöp Konteyneri Belediye Çöp Konteyneri Belediye çöp konteyneri; dış ortam atık toplama noktaları için tekerlekli, takviyeli ve uzun ömürlü CTP gövdeyle üretilebilecek bir belediye ekipmanı ürünüdür. Kompozit yapı, tuzlu hava, nem, temizlik kimyasalları ve yoğun kullanım koşullarında korozyon riskini düşürür. Belediye Kullanımı İçin Avantajlar Tekerlekli gövde ve boşaltma ekipmanına uyarlanabilir bağlantı detayları Darbe toleransı yüksek kalın cidarlı kompozit yapı Kolay yıkanabilir, hijyenik ve kokuyu tutmayan pürüzsüz yüzey İlçe, tesis veya proje rengine göre üretilebilen dış yüzey Teklif İçin Gereken Bilgiler Hacim, tekerlek tipi, kapak formu, boşaltma sistemi uyumu, adet ve renk beklentisi paylaşıldığında numune ve seri üretim planı hazırlanabilir. 06 / PRODUCT ◇ Kompozit Çöp Kutusu Kompozit Çöp Kutusu Kompozit çöp kutusu; park, bahçe, yürüyüş yolu, kampüs, otel ve belediye peyzaj alanlarında kullanılmak üzere UV dayanımlı, darbe toleranslı ve bakım ihtiyacı düşük bir kent ekipmanı olarak üretilebilir. CTP gövde, dış ortamda paslanmaz ve farklı renk/kapak varyantlarına uyarlanabilir. Ürün Özellikleri Yağmur korumalı kapak ve kolay erişimli atık açıklığı Zemine sabitlenebilir kaide veya proje bazlı ayak sistemi Kolay temizlenen iç yüzey ve opsiyonel iç kova kurgusu Belediye kimliği veya peyzaj konseptine uygun renk seçenekleri Kullanım Alanları Parklar, sahil yürüyüş yolları, sosyal tesisler, okul ve kampüs alanları, otel bahçeleri ve dış mekan şehir mobilyası projeleri için uygundur. 07 / PRODUCT ◇ Kompozit Tabut Kompozit Tabut Kompozit tabut; defin hizmetleri, belediye hizmet birimleri, cenaze ekipmanı tedarikçileri ve ihracat odaklı B2B programlar için hafif, hijyenik ve yüzey kalitesi kontrollü bir ürün ailesi olarak projelendirilebilir. Gözeneksiz CTP yüzey, kolay temizlenebilir yapı ve seri üretimde ölçü tekrarlanabilirliği sağlar. Teknik Yaklaşım Hafif taşıma ergonomisi ve yüksek gövde rijitliği Kolay dezenfekte edilebilir, pürüzsüz jel-kot yüzey Standart veya müşteri markasına özel ölçü ve renk seçenekleri Lojistik ve istifleme ihtiyacına göre taban ve kenar takviyesi Proje Kullanımı Numune onayı, teknik şartname, adet ve teslimat planı netleştirildikten sonra iç pazar veya ihracat dağıtımına uygun üretim senaryosu hazırlanabilir. 08 / PRODUCT ◇ CTP Çöp Konteyneri CTP Çöp Konteyneri CTP çöp konteyneri; belediyeler, sanayi tesisleri, toplu yaşam alanları ve peyzaj projeleri için hafif, korozyona dayanıklı ve kolay temizlenebilir atık toplama gövdesi olarak tasarlanır. Cam elyaf takviyeli polyester yapı, metal konteynerlerde görülen paslanma ve yüzey deformasyonu riskini azaltır. Üretim ve Tasarım Kapsamı Proje ihtiyacına göre farklı hacim, kapak ve gövde formları UV dayanımlı jel-kot yüzey ve istenen RAL renkte final boya Forklift cebi, takviyeli yan ribler, menteşeli kapak ve kalın cidarlı kompozit gövde Seri üretime uygun kalıp disiplini ve tekrarlanabilir yüzey kalitesi Kullanım Alanları Belediye atık toplama noktaları, fabrika sahaları, otel ve sosyal tesisler, kampüsler, parklar ve dış ortam ekipmanı gerektiren projeler için değerlendirilebilir. 09 / PRODUCT ◇ Dekoratif Kompozit Saksı ve Vazo Ürünleri Dekoratif Kompozit Saksı ve Vazo Ürünleri Peyzaj, belediye alanları, otel bahçeleri, sosyal tesisler ve dış mekan projeleri için farklı form, renk ve yüzey dokularında üretilebilen dekoratif kompozit saksı, vazo ve küp ürün grubudur. Ürün Kapsamı Yatay saksı, dik vazo, küp, amfora ve bahçe seti formları Bronz, terracotta, krem, hardal, eskitme ve proje rengine göre özel yüzeyler Hafif, taşınabilir, dış ortam koşullarına dayanıklı kompozit gövde Proje Kullanımı Tüm görseller tek ürün ailesi altında sunulur. Ölçü, renk, yüzey efekti ve adet bilgisine göre aynı kalıp ailesinden proje bazlı üretim planlanabilir. 10 / PRODUCT ◇ Cam Elyaf Servis Kapagi Cam elyaf esasli servis kapagi; dis ortam dayanimı ve kolay montaj gerektiren saha ekipmanlari icin ornek bir galeri ve urun destek kaydidir. 11 / PRODUCT ◇ CTP Koruyucu Govde Paneli CTP Koruyucu Govde Paneli Cam takviyeli polyester tabanli koruyucu govde paneli; saha dayanimı, kimyasal direnç, darbe toleransi ve tekrarli uretim ihtiyaci olan endustriyel govde uygulamalari icin tasarlanir. Muhendislik ile gorus Teklif talep et Karbon fiber, CTP ve cam elyaf tabanli uygulamalariniz icin malzeme secimi, proses, miktar ve termin beklentisini birlikte netlestirip proje bazli teklif hazirlayalim. Kompozit Lunapark Ekipmanları ve Tema Parkı Ürünleri

MOE Kompozit, cam elyaf takviyeli kompozit polyester (CTP/FRP) malzemeden lunapark ekipmanları, tema parkı ürünleri, eğlence parkı kabinleri, oyun makinesi gövdeleri, dekoratif figürler ve özel tasarım kompozit parçalar üreten uzman bir üreticidir.

Modern üretim teknolojileri, deneyimli teknik ekibi ve yüksek kalite standartlarıyla Türkiye ve uluslararası pazarlardaki lunapark üreticileri, tema parkları, eğlence merkezleri, belediyeler, AVM'ler ve oyun ekipmanı üreticileri için projeye özel çözümler sunar.

Kompozit (CTP/FRP) Nedir?

CTP/FRP, cam elyafı ile güçlendirilmiş polyester reçineden oluşan yüksek dayanımlı bir mühendislik malzemesidir. Hafif yapısı, yüksek mukavemeti ve dış ortam koşullarına karşı direnci sayesinde lunapark ve tema parkı sektöründe yaygın olarak tercih edilir.

  • Paslanmaz ve çürümez.
  • Darbelere karşı dayanıklıdır.
  • UV ve dış ortam koşullarına uygun üretilebilir.
  • Uzun süre düşük bakım ihtiyacı sunar.
  • Karmaşık ve estetik formlara imkân verir.
  • Renk ve yüzey seçenekleri projeye göre uyarlanabilir.

Ürettiğimiz Lunapark Kabinleri ve Gövdeleri

MOE Kompozit, dekoratif figürlerin yanı sıra lunapark ve tema parklarında kullanılan eğlence ekipmanlarının kompozit kabin, oturak ve dış gövdelerini de üretir.

  • Çarpışan oto kabinleri
  • Roller coaster ve hız treni vagon gövdeleri
  • Dönme dolap kabinleri
  • Balerin ünitesi oturakları
  • Discovery ve gondol kabinleri
  • Salıncak ve uçan sandalye koltukları
  • Atlı karınca parçaları
  • Çocuk ve mini tren lokomotifleri ile vagonları
  • Simülatör ve VR oyun kabinleri

pages.text: Quality control in composite manufacturing is often thought of as merely final-product inspection; in reality, true quality is a holistic discipline that spans from raw-material intake to mold preparation, from process parameters to final inspection and documentation. Because strength in composites is largely formed during production, the goal is not to detect a defect afterwards but to prevent it from occurring. In this article we cover the main stages of composite quality control, the testing methods used, and how to guarantee repeatability in series production. Main Control Stages An effective quality-control chain covers every stage of the part lifecycle: Raw material and reinforcement control: The properties and shelf life of resin, hardener and fiber are verified. Mold and process preparation: Mold surface, release agent and ambient conditions are checked. Production and layup: Number of layers, orientation and resin ratio are monitored. Dimensional measurement and tolerance: The part is compared against the drawing dimensions. Visual and surface inspection: Cracks, voids, delamination and surface defects are sought. Mechanical testing and validation: Strength tests are performed on samples when required. Testing Methods Both destructive and non-destructive testing methods are used for composites. Non-destructive testing (NDT) allows internal defects to be detected without damaging the part: Method Purpose Type Visual inspection Surface defects Non-destructive Ultrasonic testing Internal voids, delamination Non-destructive Tensile/flexural test Mechanical strength Destructive Burn-off test Fiber/resin ratio Destructive Standards and Documentation Quality control gains meaning through international standards and traceable documentation. Quality management systems such as ISO 9001 guarantee the repeatability of the process, while records kept for each batch make root-cause analysis possible in case of an issue. Traceability is the foundation of customer trust, especially in B2B and series-production projects. Why Process Repeatability is Critical Producing a single good part and producing thousands of parts at the same quality are different things. In composites, small deviations in process parameters (temperature, cure time, resin ratio) directly affect part performance. Therefore, fixing and continuously monitoring parameters during the transition to series production is one of the most critical topics. Common Defects The most common defects in composite manufacturing are resin-rich or resin-starved areas, air voids, delamination, incomplete cure and surface cracks. Most of these defects stem from deviations in process parameters or gaps in raw-material control. A defect detected at an early stage can be corrected at low cost, whereas a defect in a part already in the field is both costly and a reputational risk. For this reason, placing control points correctly along the production line is of great importance. The Business Value of Quality Control A well-designed quality-control process does not merely catch errors; it also reduces scrap rates, decreases customer returns and makes delivery times predictable. In B2B projects, consistent quality is the foundation of a long-term business relationship. Traceable records and compliance with standards put the customer's trust in the supplier on a concrete footing. In short, quality control is not a cost item but an investment that creates a competitive advantage. The Role of Digital Tools Modern quality control does not rely solely on the human eye and manual measurement. Digital calipers, 3D scanners and data-collection systems ensure that measurements are recorded consistently and tracked on a batch basis. When the collected data is analyzed with statistical process control, a deviation can be noticed before it turns into a defect. This predictive approach significantly reduces the scrap rate, especially in high-volume production, and makes quality sustainable. As a result, digital quality control turns a reactive inspection task into a proactive engineering discipline that protects both the product and the customer relationship. MOE Kompozit designs its quality-control approach according to the part's intended use and performance expectations, and runs the process with documentation from sample validation to series production. pages.text: FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) and fiberglass are often used interchangeably in everyday language, yet technically they do not mean exactly the same thing. Fiberglass is the broad, general name for glass-fiber reinforced structures. FRP describes a polymer composite reinforced with fibers, where glass fiber is the most common reinforcement. Understanding this distinction is critical to selecting the right material for a project. In this article we clarify the FRP and fiberglass concepts, the differences between them, and which one to prefer in which situation. What is FRP? FRP is a composite material in which a polymer resin is reinforced with fibers, most commonly glass. Thanks to its mechanical strength, chemical resistance and favorable cost/performance balance, it is widely used in industrial bodies, covers, panels, tanks and protective parts. The flexibility of the production methods makes it suitable for everything from small custom parts to series production. What Does Fiberglass Mean? Fiberglass is the general term for glass-fiber reinforced composites and can involve different resin systems (polyester, vinylester, epoxy). In other words, glass-reinforced FRP is a type of fiberglass, but the term fiberglass is broader. Therefore the resin type, production method and target performance must be clarified separately when making a technical decision. Key Differences Table Criterion FRP (Glass Reinforced) General Fiberglass Resin Polymer (polyester/vinylester/epoxy) Varies by application Scope Specific composite class Broad, general term Cost Economical to mid-range Depends on resin Typical use Tanks, panels, bodies, covers Insulation, marine, automotive Production Methods Glass-fiber reinforced parts can be produced by different methods, and the chosen method directly affects the quality and cost of the part: Hand lay-up: Flexible and economical for low volumes and large parts. Spray-up: Efficient for surfaces that need fast coverage. RTM (resin transfer molding): Repeatable, for parts that need two smooth surfaces. Pultrusion: A continuous process for constant cross-section profiles and rods. How to Choose the Right Material The right choice is made by evaluating factors such as the operating environment, chemical exposure, mechanical load, temperature and surface expectations together. For example, a vinylester-resin fiberglass structure may be suitable for a tank exposed to chemical attack, while an economical polyester FRP solution may be better for a standard cover. When deciding, the focus should be on technical requirements, not just naming. Advantages and Disadvantages Glass-fiber reinforced composites offer significant advantages over metals, such as light weight, corrosion resistance and ease of molding. Electrical insulation and low maintenance cost are also reasons for preference in many industrial applications. On the other hand, lower stiffness and temperature resistance compared to carbon fiber can be limiting in some high-performance applications. For this reason FRP and fiberglass provide the most sensible solution in projects where the strength/cost balance is prominent. In Which Sectors Is It Used? FRP and fiberglass structures are used across a very wide field, including water and chemical storage tanks, treatment equipment, marine hulls, automotive panels, construction reinforcement profiles and municipal equipment. The main reason for this prevalence is that the material does not corrode and can be easily adapted to different geometries. Especially in applications that expect a long life outdoors or in chemical environments, it lowers the total cost of ownership compared to metal alternatives. Maintenance and Long Life One of the biggest advantages of FRP and fiberglass products is their low maintenance requirement. Because they do not corrode, they do not need regular painting or rust protection like metal structures. Nevertheless, it should be remembered that the gelcoat layer on the surface can dull over time under UV exposure; although this does not affect structural strength, it can be addressed with periodic surface care. A properly produced FRP part can serve for decades under suitable conditions, and this long life more than compensates for the initial investment cost. pages.text: Composite materials are rapidly replacing traditional metals across many sectors. Thanks to their light weight, durability, corrosion resistance and design flexibility, their use in automotive, energy, construction and defense grows every year. Several key trends stand out that will accelerate this growth in the coming period. In this article we cover the technological and sector trends shaping the future of industrial composite solutions. Trends Shaping the Future The main topics setting the direction of composite technology in the coming years are: Electric vehicle lightweighting: Structural parts that reduce vehicle weight to extend range. Wind turbine blades: Longer, lighter and more efficient blade designs. 3D printed composites: Rapid prototyping and production for complex geometries. Recyclable composites: Thermoplastic resins and a circular-economy approach. Smart composites: Structures with embedded sensors that can monitor their own condition. Sector Impact Table Sector Expected Impact Key Application Automotive Lightweighting, range increase Chassis and body parts Energy Efficiency increase Turbine blades Construction Corrosion-free strength Reinforcement profiles Defense Strength-to-weight Protective panels Sustainability and Recycling One of the most important topics facing the composite sector is sustainability. While traditional thermoset resins create structures that are difficult to recycle, emerging thermoplastic composites and new recovery methods aim to extend the material's life cycle. The circular-economy approach will become a decisive criterion in material selection in the future. Digitalization in Manufacturing Simulation, digital twin and automation technologies are making composite manufacturing more predictable and repeatable. Simulating the laminate design in advance reduces faulty production and shortens development time. These digital tools make it possible for even small manufacturers to reach high engineering quality. Market Growth Dynamics The global composite market is growing steadily due to pressure for lightweighting and energy efficiency. Emission targets in automotive, the shift to renewable sources in energy, and the need for durable infrastructure in construction are factors that directly increase composite demand. This growth is not limited to large manufacturers; mid-sized producers that work with the right engineering approach also capture significant opportunities in value-added niche applications. Opportunities for Emerging Manufacturers Thanks to a strong manufacturing base and favorable geography, regions like Turkey hold a competitive position in composite production. The development of local engineering capacity reduces dependence on imported products while increasing export potential. A wide range of applications, from amusement-park equipment to industrial enclosures, from agricultural equipment to municipal products, creates a sustainable growth area for local manufacturers. With the right material and process selection, these opportunities can be turned into concrete products that compete on both quality and price in international markets. Innovations in Material Development Advances in resin chemistry continuously expand the limits of composites. Faster-curing resins increase production speed, while bio-based resins reduce the environmental footprint. Structures that use carbon and glass fiber in hybrid form make it possible to strike new balances between cost and performance. Nano-additives, meanwhile, improve properties such as impact resistance and surface quality. These innovations make composites a genuine alternative in many applications where metal was previously mandatory. Takeaways for Designers Success in future composite projects depends on involving the material in the design at an early stage. When part geometry, load direction and production method are planned as a whole, the freedom that composites offer can be fully exploited. For this reason, early collaboration between engineering and production teams is the most effective approach to reducing both cost and development time. Investing in skilled engineers who understand laminate design, resin chemistry and production processes remains the single most decisive factor in unlocking the full potential of composite materials. MOE Kompozit follows these trends to offer its customers composite solutions suited not only to today's needs but also to those of the future. pages.text: Carbon fiber is an advanced reinforcement material made of extremely thin filaments, roughly 5-10 microns in diameter, composed mostly of carbon atoms. When these filaments are combined with a resin system (typically epoxy), the result is a composite known in engineering as CFRP (Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer). The defining advantage of carbon fiber is its ability to deliver high strength at very low weight, offering a far more efficient strength-to-weight ratio than metals. This guide covers the core properties of carbon fiber, how it is manufactured, the industries that rely on it, and the engineering decisions required to achieve the right result. Key Properties of Carbon Fiber The technical edge of carbon fiber comes not from a single trait but from a combination of them: High strength-to-weight ratio: Achieves the same strength with a much lighter structure. High stiffness: With proper laminate design it deflects minimally under load. Dimensional stability: A low thermal expansion coefficient keeps its shape across temperature changes. Corrosion resistance: Unlike metals it does not rust and withstands humid, chemical environments. Fatigue resistance: Provides a long service life under repeated loads. Comparison with Steel and Aluminum Comparing carbon fiber with common engineering materials makes its advantage concrete: Property Carbon Fiber (CFRP) Steel Aluminum Density (g/cm³) 1.5 - 1.6 7.8 2.7 Specific strength Very high Medium Medium Corrosion resistance Excellent Poor Good Design flexibility High Limited Medium How is Carbon Fiber Produced? Carbon fiber is usually produced by subjecting PAN (polyacrylonitrile) based precursor fibers to controlled thermal processes. The process broadly includes the following stages: Stabilization: Precursor fibers are heated to 200-300 °C in an oxygen environment to make the structure stable. Carbonization: At high temperature in an oxygen-free environment, non-carbon atoms are removed and the carbon chain densifies. Surface treatment and sizing: The fiber surface is prepared to improve adhesion to the resin. Weaving or unidirectional layup: Fibers are turned into fabric, tape or unidirectional plies. Application Areas Carbon fiber stands out wherever strength and low weight are simultaneously critical. In aerospace and defense it is used for fuselage panels and structural components, in automotive for performance parts and lightweighting, in sports equipment for bicycle frames and rackets, and in industry for robot arms, custom machine components and protective enclosures. In the energy sector, large structures such as wind turbine blades also benefit from composite technology. An Engineering Approach for the Right Result Material selection alone is not enough to obtain the expected performance from carbon fiber. The resin system, number and orientation of layers, surface quality expectations and the production process must all be evaluated together. A poor laminate design can produce a weak part even with the right material. For this reason the project, the material and the geometry must be addressed together. Types and Grades of Carbon Fiber Carbon fiber is not a single material but a family with different mechanical properties. By modulus it is classified as standard modulus, intermediate modulus and high modulus; high-modulus fibers are stiffer, while standard-modulus fibers generally behave tougher. Fibers are also named by tow size, such as 3K, 6K and 12K, where the number expresses the count of filaments in a tow in thousands. The weave form matters too: unidirectional plies carry load most efficiently along a single axis, while woven fabrics provide multi-axis strength and easier draping. The right grade is chosen according to the working direction of the part and the expected stiffness. Frequently Asked Questions Does carbon fiber rust? No; carbon fiber itself does not corrode, but galvanic-corrosion isolation must be applied at metal connection points. Is carbon fiber brittle? A properly designed laminate can show high impact resistance; brittleness is often the result of poor laminate design rather than the nature of the material. Is it suitable for every application? Because of its cost, glass-fiber reinforced alternatives may be more economical where weight and stiffness are not critical. For this reason the material decision should always be made by evaluating technical requirements and budget together. MOE Kompozit manages engineering support, sample validation and the transition to series production together, according to project needs. This ensures the theoretical advantage of the material is consistently reflected in the real part on the field. pages.text: CTP (Cam Takviyeli Polyester) ile fiberglass kavramları günlük kullanımda çoğu zaman birbirinin yerine geçecek şekilde kullanılır; ancak teknik olarak tamamen aynı şeyi ifade etmezler. Fiberglass, cam elyaf takviyeli yapıların geniş ve genel adıdır. CTP ise cam elyafın özel olarak polyester reçine ile birleştirildiği belirli bir kompozit türünü tanımlar. Bu ayrımı bilmek, projeye doğru malzemeyi seçmek için kritik öneme sahiptir. Bu yazıda CTP ve fiberglass kavramlarını netleştiriyor, aralarındaki farkları ve hangi durumda hangisinin tercih edilmesi gerektiğini ele alıyoruz. CTP Nedir? CTP, cam elyafın polyester reçine ile birleştirilmesiyle elde edilen bir kompozit malzemedir. Mekanik dayanım, kimyasal direnç ve uygun maliyet/performans dengesi sayesinde endüstriyel gövde, kapak, panel, tank ve koruyucu parçalarda yaygın olarak kullanılır. Üretim yönteminin esnekliği, küçük adetli özel parçalardan seri üretime kadar geniş bir yelpazeye uyum sağlar. Fiberglass Ne Anlama Gelir? Fiberglass, cam elyaf takviyeli kompozitlerin genel adıdır ve farklı reçine sistemlerini (polyester, vinilester, epoksi) kapsayabilir. Yani her CTP bir fiberglass yapıdır, ancak her fiberglass yapı CTP değildir. Bu nedenle teknik kararda kullanılan reçine tipi, üretim yöntemi ve hedef performans ayrıca netleştirilmelidir. Temel Farklar Tablosu Kriter CTP (Cam Takviyeli Polyester) Genel Fiberglass Reçine Polyester (belirli) Polyester / vinilester / epoksi Kapsam Spesifik kompozit türü Geniş, genel terim Maliyet Ekonomik Reçineye göre değişir Tipik kullanım Tank, panel, gövde, kapak İzolasyon, denizcilik, otomotiv Üretim Yöntemleri Cam elyaf takviyeli parçalar farklı yöntemlerle üretilebilir ve seçilen yöntem, parçanın kalitesini ve maliyetini doğrudan etkiler: El yatırması (hand lay-up): Düşük adet ve büyük parçalar için esnek ve ekonomik. Püskürtme (spray-up): Hızlı kaplama gerektiren yüzeylerde verimli. RTM (reçine transfer kalıplama): Tekrarlanabilir, iki yüzeyi de düzgün parçalar için. Pultruzyon: Sabit kesitli profil ve çubuk üretiminde sürekli proses. Doğru Malzeme Nasıl Seçilir? Doğru seçim; parçanın çalışma ortamı, maruz kalacağı kimyasallar, mekanik yük, sıcaklık ve yüzey beklentisi gibi faktörlerin birlikte değerlendirilmesiyle yapılır. Örneğin kimyasal saldırıya açık bir tank için vinilester reçineli bir fiberglass yapı, standart bir kapak için ise ekonomik bir CTP çözümü daha uygun olabilir. Karar verirken yalnızca isimlendirmeye değil, teknik gereksinimlere odaklanmak gerekir. Avantaj ve Dezavantajlar Cam elyaf takviyeli kompozitler, metallere kıyasla hafiflik, korozyon direnci ve kalıplama kolaylığı gibi önemli avantajlar sunar. Elektriksel yalıtkanlık ve düşük bakım maliyeti de birçok endüstriyel uygulamada tercih sebebidir. Öte yandan, karbon fibere göre daha düşük rijitlik ve sıcaklık dayanımı, bazı yüksek performanslı uygulamalarda sınırlayıcı olabilir. Bu nedenle CTP veya fiberglass, dayanım/maliyet dengesinin öne çıktığı projelerde en mantıklı çözümü oluşturur. Hangi Sektörlerde Kullanılır? CTP ve fiberglass yapılar; su ve kimyasal depolama tankları, arıtma ekipmanları, denizcilik tekne gövdeleri, otomotiv panelleri, inşaat güçlendirme profilleri ve belediye ekipmanları gibi çok geniş bir alanda kullanılır. Bu yaygınlığın temel nedeni, malzemenin korozyona uğramaması ve farklı geometrilere kolayca uyarlanabilmesidir. Özellikle açık havada veya kimyasal ortamda uzun ömür beklenen uygulamalarda, metal alternatiflerine göre toplam sahip olma maliyetini düşürür. Bakım ve Uzun Ömür CTP ve fiberglass ürünlerin en büyük avantajlarından biri, düşük bakım gereksinimleridir. Korozyona uğramadıkları için metal yapılar gibi düzenli boya veya pas koruma işlemi gerektirmezler. Buna rağmen yüzeydeki jelkot katmanının UV etkisiyle zamanla matlaşabileceği unutulmamalıdır; bu durum yapısal dayanımı etkilemese de görsel olarak periyodik bir yüzey bakımıyla giderilebilir. Doğru üretilmiş bir CTP parça, uygun koşullarda onlarca yıl hizmet verebilir ve bu uzun ömür, ilk yatırım maliyetini fazlasıyla telafi eder. Maliyet ve Tedarik Avantajı CTP çözümlerinin bir diğer önemli avantajı, kalıp maliyetinin metal kalıplara göre genellikle daha düşük olması ve küçük adetli üretimlerde bile ekonomik kalabilmesidir. Bu esneklik, özellikle prototip ve özel proje süreçlerinde tasarımı hızla doğrulama imkânı sunar. Ayrıca yerli üretim sayesinde tedarik süreleri kısalır ve revizyon ihtiyaçlarına hızlı yanıt verilebilir. Bu da projeyi yöneten mühendis için hem zaman hem bütçe açısından öngörülebilirlik anlamına gelir. MOE Kompozit, projenin teknik gereksinimlerini analiz ederek doğru reçine ve üretim yöntemini önerir; numune aşamasından seri üretime kadar süreci birlikte yürütür. pages.text: Kompozit malzemeler, geleneksel metallerin yerini birçok sektörde hızla almaktadır. Hafiflik, dayanıklılık, korozyon direnci ve tasarım esnekliği sayesinde otomotiv, enerji, inşaat ve savunma sektörlerinde kullanımı her yıl artmaktadır. Önümüzdeki dönemde bu büyümeyi hızlandıracak birkaç temel trend öne çıkıyor. Bu yazıda endüstriyel kompozit çözümlerin geleceğini şekillendiren teknolojik ve sektörel eğilimleri ele alıyoruz. Geleceği Şekillendiren Trendler Kompozit teknolojisinin önümüzdeki yıllardaki yönünü belirleyen başlıca başlıklar şunlardır: Elektrikli araç hafifletme: Menzili artırmak için araç ağırlığını düşüren yapısal parçalar. Rüzgâr türbini kanatları: Daha uzun, daha hafif ve daha verimli kanat tasarımları. 3D baskı ile kompozit üretim: Karmaşık geometrilerde hızlı prototip ve üretim. Geri dönüştürülebilir kompozitler: Termoplastik reçineler ve döngüsel ekonomi yaklaşımı. Akıllı kompozitler: Sensör gömülü, kendi durumunu izleyebilen yapılar. Sektörel Etki Tablosu Sektör Beklenen Etki Öne Çıkan Uygulama Otomotiv Hafifletme, menzil artışı Şasi ve gövde parçaları Enerji Verim artışı Türbin kanatları İnşaat Korozyonsuz dayanım Güçlendirme profilleri Savunma Dayanım/ağırlık Koruyucu paneller Sürdürülebilirlik ve Geri Dönüşüm Kompozit sektörünün önündeki en önemli başlıklardan biri sürdürülebilirliktir. Geleneksel termoset reçineler geri dönüştürülmesi zor yapılar oluştururken, gelişen termoplastik kompozitler ve yeni geri kazanım yöntemleri malzemenin yaşam döngüsünü uzatmayı hedefler. Döngüsel ekonomi yaklaşımı, gelecekte malzeme seçiminde belirleyici bir kriter haline gelecektir. Üretimde Dijitalleşme Simülasyon, dijital ikiz ve otomasyon teknolojileri kompozit üretimini daha öngörülebilir ve tekrarlanabilir hale getiriyor. Katman tasarımının önceden simüle edilmesi, hatalı üretimi azaltır ve geliştirme süresini kısaltır. Bu dijital araçlar, küçük üreticilerin bile yüksek mühendislik kalitesine ulaşmasını mümkün kılıyor. Pazarın Büyüme Dinamikleri Küresel kompozit pazarı, hafifletme ve enerji verimliliği baskısı nedeniyle istikrarlı biçimde büyümektedir. Otomotivde emisyon hedefleri, enerjide yenilenebilir kaynaklara geçiş ve inşaatta dayanıklı altyapı ihtiyacı, kompozit talebini doğrudan artıran etkenlerdir. Bu büyüme yalnızca büyük üreticilerle sınırlı değildir; doğru mühendislik yaklaşımıyla çalışan orta ölçekli üreticiler de katma değerli niş uygulamalarda önemli fırsatlar yakalamaktadır. Türkiye İçin Fırsatlar Türkiye, güçlü imalat altyapısı ve coğrafi konumu sayesinde kompozit üretiminde rekabetçi bir konuma sahiptir. Yerli mühendislik kapasitesinin gelişmesi, ithal ürünlere bağımlılığı azaltırken ihracat potansiyelini de artırmaktadır. Lunapark ekipmanlarından endüstriyel muhafazalara, tarım ekipmanlarından belediye ürünlerine kadar geniş bir uygulama yelpazesi, yerli üreticiler için sürdürülebilir bir büyüme alanı oluşturur. Doğru malzeme ve proses seçimiyle bu fırsatlar somut ürünlere dönüştürülebilir. Malzeme Geliştirmedeki Yenilikler Reçine kimyasındaki gelişmeler, kompozitlerin sınırlarını sürekli genişletmektedir. Daha hızlı kürleşen reçineler üretim hızını artırırken, biyo-bazlı reçineler çevresel ayak izini azaltıyor. Karbon ve cam elyafın hibrit kullanıldığı yapılar, maliyet ve performans arasında yeni dengeler kurmayı mümkün kılıyor. Nano katkılar ise darbe dayanımı ve yüzey kalitesi gibi özellikleri iyileştiriyor. Bu yenilikler, daha önce metalin zorunlu olduğu birçok uygulamada kompoziti gerçek bir alternatif haline getiriyor. Tasarımcılar İçin Çıkarımlar Geleceğin kompozit projelerinde başarı, malzemeyi erken aşamada tasarıma dahil etmekten geçiyor. Parça geometrisi, yük yönü ve üretim yöntemi bir bütün olarak planlandığında, kompozitin sunduğu serbestlik tam anlamıyla kullanılabiliyor. Bu nedenle mühendislik ve üretim ekiplerinin erken iş birliği, hem maliyeti hem de geliştirme süresini düşüren en etkili yaklaşımdır. Eğitim ve Yetkinlik İhtiyacı Kompozit teknolojisinin yaygınlaşması, nitelikli iş gücü ihtiyacını da beraberinde getiriyor. Katman tasarımı, reçine kimyası ve üretim prosesleri konusunda yetkin mühendisler, bu malzemenin potansiyelini açığa çıkaran en kritik unsurdur. Üniversite-sanayi iş birlikleri ve uygulamalı eğitim programları, sektörün gelecekteki büyümesini destekleyecek temel yatırımlardır. Teknoloji ne kadar gelişirse gelişsin, doğru sonucu üreten her zaman bilgili insan ve disiplinli süreç olmaya devam edecektir. Bu nedenle kompozit sektörünün geleceği, yalnızca yeni makinelere değil, aynı zamanda bu makineleri doğru kullanacak nitelikli mühendis ve teknisyen kadrosuna yapılan yatırımla şekillenecektir. MOE Kompozit, bu trendleri takip ederek müşterilerine yalnızca bugünün değil, geleceğin gereksinimlerine de uygun kompozit çözümler sunmayı hedefler.
